There's a theme around love being a battlefield, focusing on the heart and conflict, which highlights the complexity of love and relationships.**Exploring expressions of love and conflict**

I'm delving into the main expression around love and conflict. "Bury your heart" could resonate here, but perhaps "love conquers all" isn't quite fitting. I'm thinking of the phrase "digging yourself into a hole," which combines the idea of turmoil and conflict with a digging tool. There’s also a connection to “bury the hatchet,” an idiom suggesting peace after conflict, highlighting themes of reconciliation and love. Another possible phrase is "war of hearts," capturing the struggle within relationships.
